statements.subject: connection
statements.description: Both the client and server MUST check the result of the STARTTLS command and subsequent TLS negotiation to see whether acceptable authentication and/or privacy was achieved.
statements.trigger: STARTTLS command result and TLS negotiation completion
actions: check TLS negotiation outcome for acceptable authentication and/or privacy

statements.subject: client
statements.description: During the TLS negotiation, the client MUST check its understanding of the server hostname against the server's identity as presented in the server Certificate message, in order to prevent on-path attackers attempting to masquerade as the server.
actions: verify server hostname against server Certificate message identity
